statement: "You can activate 1 of these effects (but you can only use each effect of X once per turn)" limits each of the effects it lists on its own: the effect can be activated again that turn, but not by choosing one already chosen, even when that activation or its effect was negated.

sources.says: In a turn Volcanic Rimfire's effect was activated and that activation or effect was negated, the effect can be activated again, but not with the same choice: the choice was made although it was negated. The same goes for the cards it lists, Clown Crew Meteor among them.
